attributes.name: Aponavicius
attributes.powers:
Aponavicius cannot be evaded and is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits.

Before you act, succeed at a Knowledge or Perception 16 check or you are dealt 1d6 Combat damage; for each card you discard as damage, also discard the top card of the blessings deck.

After you act, each character at this and a random other location is dealt 2d4+1 Combat damage.
